During training, you meet an unfamiliar 
woman. She bluntly declares that your 
"training regimen is too soft."

The cold critique continued further. 
Stating that the Academy's educational 
policy of respecting the Umamusume's 
autonomy was wrong.

Even that distant forest maintains its 
beauty through human management. She says 
the very same principle applies to 
Umamusume.

Yes, she was none other than the Acting 
Principal dispatched to the academy, Riko 
Kashimoto.
